headlines.title: Bank of Japan Governor Says Further Rate Hikes Possible Amid Higher Inflation Risks
Schroder Japan's Taketsume steps up hunt for undervalued stocks after AI boom helps deliver 41% annual return
Asian shares mostly advance after Wall Street gains and oil prices fall
Japan's Nikkei Rises 1%, Buoyed by Wall Street Gains, Lower Oil Prices
Japanese Yen: Pares gains against US Dollar but BoJ outlook supportive - MUFG
Japanese Yen drifts lower as sustained USD buying offsets intervention fears

marketTone.ko: 일본 증시는 글로벌 증시 강세와 유가 하락에 힘입어 닛케이 지수가 1% 상승하는 등 전반적으로 강세를 보였습니다. 한편, 일본은행(BOJ) 총재는 높은 인플레이션 위험을 언급하며 추가 금리 인상 가능성을 시사했습니다. 이러한 BOJ의 매파적 전망은 엔화에 지지 요인이 될 수 있으나, 지속적인 달러 매수세로 인해 엔화는 대미 달러 대비 상승폭을 반납하고 하락하는 모습을 보였습니다.
marketTone.en: Japanese equities advanced today, with the Nikkei rising 1%, buoyed by positive global sentiment, Wall Street gains, and falling oil prices. A key focus remains on the Bank of Japan, as its Governor indicated further rate hikes are possible amid higher inflation risks. While the BoJ's outlook offers some support, the Japanese Yen saw mixed movements, paring gains and drifting lower against the US Dollar due to sustained USD buying offsetting intervention fears.
